author: pepepisshands
quote:
This isn't GTA. It's a mediocre romance RPG on rails, and there's no getting off them.

I feel for Jason. Lucia, on the other hand, is so relentlessly unlikeable that every time she opened her mouth I wanted to turn her into red mist. She plays less like a character and more like someone at Rockstar working through their own issues on the page. It's peak projection if you ask me.

And who asked for painting walls and fixing stairs in a GTA game? Nobody comes to this series for home renovation. You can't even steal all the cars in the game.

The real dealbreaker, though, is performance. The game can look stunning, but it regularly dips below 20fps, and chugging along at 15fps in the middle **** or car chase is unacceptable at £90.

I refunded it after two hours. That was more than enough to know this isn't the game I was waiting for.

author: pepepisshands
quote: Honestly just buy GT6, you might not be able to go online anymore but it's a better game in basically every way. Polyphony Digital is a scummy company, I can't believe this is £70 and feels like a freemium game, Microtransactions shouldn't be in this game and the scummy tactics of nerfing the race payouts is despicable. Thank god I borrowed a PS5 and didn't buy one, I'm just going to buy an Xbox Series X now given GT7 is such a letdown and Forza 7 still is a better game.
